original_test_intent: Verify the complete SMBIOS Type 2 baseboard identity, features and topology links against the approved platform recipe and confirm persistence after reboot.
original_method: Collect the full raw/decoded Type 2 record on the bound host, compare ten named values including optional fields and handle relationships, reboot only with approval and recovery, then repeat and diff pre/post/specification evidence.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the board recipe, allowed empty-field policy and expected handle graph, approves protected evidence and the reboot, and provides recovery access.
required_inputs: Expected Chassis Handle and Contained Object Handle targets
safety_requirements: Protect serial, asset and handle inventory
Do not suppress decoder errors or bypass host authentication
Capture complete Type 2 and referenced structures
Do not accept unresolved or dangling handles
Stop on wrong target or boot failure
agent_execution_scope: Validate decoder, oracle and privacy controls
Capture complete Type 2 plus referenced-handle records
Compare values, optionality and link targets
Produce restricted pre/post/specification and topology diff
engineer_actions: Supply expected board fields and handle graph

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 2` is the correct core read, but `grep -iA1` omits nearly every required field and all handle targets; insecure SSH and hidden errors prevent trustworthy evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture complete Type 2 and the SMBIOS structures referenced by chassis/contained-object handles before and after an approved reboot, then compare values and graph relationships to the recipe.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The ten source-named board fields, correctness, before/after comparison, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent Type 2 as a typed inventory node linked to resolved SMBIOS handles, retaining raw bytes/output and reporting absent optional values explicitly.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds relationship validation and privacy-aware complete evidence rather than a header snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong board identity, feature bits, chassis association, dangling handles and reboot drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Handle numbers may be regenerated while relationships remain equivalent; the project must define whether exact numeric stability or semantic link stability is required.

project_override_considerations: The platform recipe must define optional/empty Type 2 fields and the expected relationship graph. It may permit renumbered handles only when their resolved semantic targets remain identical.
expected_evidence: No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently names SMBIOS Type 2 fields and reboot persistence; the `Asset Tage` typo does not change the clear Asset Tag intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field oracle, optionality/link policy, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; their absence delays execution but not review completion.

review_improvement: Prevents a one-line header or value-only comparison from overlooking wrong baseboard-to-chassis and contained-object relationships.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 2 includes both inventory values and handles into the SMBIOS object graph. A record can have plausible strings yet be structurally wrong if its Chassis Handle is dangling or points to the wrong enclosure. Complete relationship-aware evidence is therefore case-specific; the confirmed reboot dependency keeps the classification REQUIRES.
